metadata.title: New Curvature Operator of the Second Kind Conditions for Rigidity
metadata.abstract: We establish Tachibana-type rigidity theorems with the aid of the curvature operator of the second kind (COSK). A sharp estimate that combines the symmetric and commutator actions on Weyl tensors leads to a constant $C_{n}$, with $\frac{C_{n}}{n}\to\frac{5}{4}$, such that a complete Einstein manifold of dimension $n\geq5$ with $C_{n}$-nonnegative COSK has constant nonnegative sectional curvature. We also explore shifted curvature operators of the second kind leading to similar rigidity results, offer an elegant Ricci-corrected Bochner identity for harmonic forms, and classify the complete simply connected locally symmetric Einstein manifolds in the resulting shifted cone. Explicit spaces establish the sharpness of the tensor estimates, and complete lists of the eigenvalues of the COSKs for symmetric spaces identify which of them are borderline cases.

analysis.progressType: 第二类曲率算子的 Einstein 刚性
analysis.workSummary: 定理 1.1 对完整连通 Einstein、n≥5 的 Cₙ-nonnegative 第二类曲率算子推出常非负截曲率，Cₙ/n→5/4。作者以 Weyl 的 symmetric 与 commutator 作用联合锐界改善 Bochner 权重；shifted operator 对调和形式给平行性，并分类其局部对称 Einstein 模型。
analysis.breakthrough: 联合权重估计超越两种作用分别估计，形成更宽的 Einstein 刚性锥。
analysis.limitations: n=4 有 CP² 边界例外，不能使用 n≥5 的常曲率结论。Conjecture A、B 仍未解决；张量估计最优与完整几何阈值最优应区分。
analysis.aiEvidence: 作者披露 ChatGPT 协助发展论文，尤其是附录 A 的表示论计算和谱表；全文另有 AI 型对称空间记号，未将该记号算作独立披露。

aiReview.note: 对该版本全部可提取页面做 AI 披露关键词检索，并核对命中段落；这不是对整篇数学证明的审读。作者披露 ChatGPT 协助发展论文，尤其是附录 A 的表示论计算和谱表；全文另有 AI 型对称空间记号，未将该记号算作独立披露。
